scientific_limitations_and_integrity: The result concerns the Euclidean regular-simplex realization and affine images of its ellipsoids, not numerical radii for arbitrary Euclidean simplices. The primary source already gives all vertices, facets, and a tetrahedral face-plane distance; a previously unindexed general ellipsoid result remains a literature risk. Exact finite checking corroborates but does not replace the all-dimensional proof.
title: Exact John and Löwner ellipsoids of the trisected-simplex central polytope
